translation.name: In yancuic mononotzalistli ica Totecohtzin Jesucristo

book.name: 1 JUAN
book.title: IN ACHTO ITLAHCUILOLAMATZIN TLEN OQUIMOIHCUILUI IN TETIOTLATITLANIL JUAN

content: Itlahtoltzin in Dios quitemaca nemilistli nochipa

Namechtlahcuiluiya teca in Jesucristo oc se tetoca Tecualnextzin in Dios aquin quitemacalo nemilistli nochipa. Huan Yehhuatzin achto oilohuaya ihcuac opeu nochin in tlalticpac. Huan tehhuan titetiotlatitlaniluan otitecajque huan otiteitaque ica toixtelolo huan otitemachilihque ica toman.

Huan Yehhuatzin ohualuilohuac nican tlalticpac ic mateixmatican huan tehhuan titetlatitlaniluan otiteitaque, huan ticchipautoque teca Yehhuatzin. Huan tamechmatiltiyahque namehhuan quen Yehhuatzin quitemacalo nemilistli nochipa. Oilohuaya tehuan Tohueyitahtzin huan satepa ohualuilohuac nican tlalticpac ic matechnextililo.

Tamechtlapohuiliyahque tel, in tlen tiquitztoque huan tlen ticactoque, huan ic inon matimosetilican quen nochin tlaneltocanimen mosetilisque tehuan Dios Tohueyitahtzin huan tehuan Iconetzin Jesucristo.
Ijcon tel, tamechtlahcuiluiyahque inin cuali tlahtoli ic xipacyetocan.
Canin tlanesis ica in tonaltzintli ahmo oncan in tlayohuilotl. Ijcon campa ilohuac in Dios ahmo oncan tlahtlacoli tleca Tehhuatzin tlamelajcan.
Tla tiquihtosque timosetilihtoque tehuan ihcuac tinemisque ipan in tlayohuilotl, ijcon tiistlacatihque ica tlen tiquihtohuahque huan ica nochin tlen ticchihuahque.

Huan in tla tinemisque ipan in tlanextli quenin Dios ilohuac ipan inon tlanextli, ijcon timosetilisque se huan oc seya, huan ica in iyestzin Iconetzin Jesucristo techchipahualos ica nochin in tlahtlacoli.
Huan tla tiquihtosque ahmo ticpiyahque tlahtlacoli, san tehhuan timocahcayahuahque huan ijcon tiistlacatihque.

Huan tla tictemocuitisque in totlahtlacol, cuali titetemachisque in Dios quen Yehhuahtzin moyecchihua tlen tlamelajcan. Techtlapohpoluilos ica totlahtlacol huan techchipahualos ica nochin tlen ahmo cuali.
Huan tla tiquihtosque ahmo ticchiutoque tlahtlacoli, san teca timahuiltiyahque huan tiquihtohuahque mach Yehhuatzin Dios quistlacatihua. Huan ijcon tehhuanten ahmo titlamelajcanten.
